soi.text: Tamiyo drifts through Thraben Cathedral, studying the oldest histories of Avacyn to learn why Innistrad is off its axis, when she finds a mad Jace standing over a collapsed librarian.
She shields her own mind and calms his thoughts with a story, then agrees to anchor him if they link minds, though she says she is here only to understand and chronicle, not to fix the plane.

When Avacyn arrives and attacks them as impure intruders, Tamiyo fights her with the story Winter's Howl, but Avacyn breaks free, and Tamiyo refuses Jace's plea to open the scroll, telling the dying Jace that sometimes stories have to end.
Once Avacyn is gone, Tamiyo warns of consequences, saying the plane has lost its protector as the cathedral's glass shatters.

emn.text: Tamiyo refuses to come with Jace when he resolves to bring the Gatewatch to Innistrad, saying that is not her path, but she shields his mind so that he can planeswalk away.
She returns when Emrakul unfolds, and Jace watches the titan's lattices cover Tamiyo's eyes, mouth and hands, erasing her ability to see, speak and write.

Tamiyo explains that Emrakul cannot be destroyed and must be bound, and she proposes attuning a binding spell to Innistrad's moon, reading a second iron-banded scroll to complete it until Emrakul is bound in the moon.

Afterward she declines Gideon's invitation to join the Gatewatch, and tells Jace that Emrakul took her over to read the scroll and cast a changed spell that trapped herself, then flies off into the dark sky.

dbl.text: On Kamigawa, Tamiyo paralyzes Kaito with a scroll spell, then releases him on learning he knows of Tezzeret, and introduces herself and her son Nashi.
She tells him about the Reality Chip and that the Wanderer and the emperor are one and the same, and later she places the chip on the emperor's hand to stabilize her for a time.

Walking into Tezzeret's trap at the lab, Tamiyo is restrained and later freed when the Wanderer cleaves Jin-Gitaxias, but in the end Tezzeret takes control of the chip on her hand and drags her through a portal.

neo.text: Tamiyo and Kaito charge into Jin-Gitaxias's secret lab, unaware that the praetor was eagerly awaiting them, after the Wanderer entrusts the Reality Chip to Tamiyo to keep it from him.
The Wanderer cuts Jin-Gitaxias in half, but Tezzeret recovers his body and rebuilds him on New Phyrexia, where he compleats Tamiyo into the first Phyrexian planeswalker.
Before her compleation Tamiyo stores all of her memories within a scroll, and Nashi vows to find his mother.
